what: Put one WebGL 3D object (a sphere, a front-facing six-point star balloon, a rippling blob) at the center of the board and draw contour stripes on its surface — distort the distance field of five spots on the sphere surface (circle, rounded triangle, rounded square, ellipse, circle) with noise (.165 × size .42), one line every .064, each ring’s thickness breathes ±16%, and the lines flow slowly outward (flow time = sec × .15). When the cursor comes within 420px of the object’s screen center, the lines thicken from .109 to .274 (following by .08 per frame), and dragging rotates it (sensitivity 2.2 · follow .35, on release ×.955 per frame). On receiving an fx:shape event (sphere · star · blob), the shape blends and changes over 1.05s cubic in-out

options.width: Line thickness at rest (share of half period), default .109
options.boost: Weight added when the cursor is dead center, default .165 — 0 means no reaction
options.reach: Cursor distance (px) at which thickening begins, default 420
options.drag: Drag sensitivity, default 2.2 — 0 means no rotation
options.damp: Rotation share left in each frame after release, default .955
options.size: Object Diameter = Panel short side × size, default .8
options.morph: Duration of the shape change (seconds), default 1.05 — 0 means immediately

use: <section data-fx="contour-blob-gl" data-fx-contour-blob-gl="shape: star" style="height: 80vh"></section> — Change shape: el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:shape", { detail: "blob" })). The line color is --kf-accent, and the gaps between lines are empty so the panel background shows
note: Load THREE (_vendor/three@0.174.0) first as window.THREE. Shaders are precompiled when attached. On phones, swiping vertically scrolls the page (touch-action: pan-y) and dragging horizontally spins it — the cursor-thickness reaction is for hover devices only. With reduce, it draws just one still frame with the flow stopped and redraws only while dragging

from.where: shared.js stage objects (sphere·star balloon·lump) — original motif shader: spacing .016×4·thickness .109 (+.165·420px·.08)·noise .165/.42·flow .15·ring breath .09/.16, drag 2.2/.35/.955, shape change 1.05s easeInOutCubic
